Buccal (TMJ) Massage

Relieve jaw pain, headaches, and upper body tension.

Book a Free Consultation

What Is Buccal (TMJ) Massage?

This 60-minute session is focused on relieving tension in the jaw, head, neck, and upper extremities. Using a combination of gentle intraoral (inside the mouth) and external myofascial release techniques, I address the key muscles involved in TMJ dysfunction and related tension patterns.

While many people think of TMJ as just a jaw issue, the tension often radiates throughout the head, neck, shoulders, and even down the arms. This treatment takes a whole-body approach to provide lasting relief.

TMJ pain & jaw tension

Techniques I Use

Intraoral Myofascial Release External Myofascial Release Trigger Point Therapy Scalp & Sinus Release Neck & Shoulder Mobilization Arm & Hand Tension Release

Who Benefits from TMJ Massage?

Chronic jaw clenchers
Nighttime teeth grinders
Desk workers with forward head posture
Anyone with chronic tension in the upper body
Sinus pressure sufferers
Anyone seeking relief from daily stress held in the jaw

What to Expect

Session Length

60 minutes of focused, hands-on work.

Intraoral Work

Gentle, gloved work inside the mouth on the pterygoid and masseter muscles. Always within your comfort level.

How It Feels

Clients often describe the sensation as a deep release—like the jaw and head can finally rest. Most notice significant relief after just one session.
